records.key: How a spot becomes a base: which channel carries which letter, how much brighter than its surroundings a spot must be to count as a read at all, and how far from a nucleus a read may lie and still be that nucleus's. These are measured properties of the acquisition rather than preferences, and the run reports the library match rate that says whether they are right.
records.source: How a spot becomes a base: which channel carries which letter, how much brighter than its surroundings a spot must be to count as a read at all, and how far from a nucleus a read may lie and still be that nucleus's. These are measured properties of the acquisition rather than preferences, and the run reports the library match rate that says whether they are right.
records.translation: Hur en punkt blir en bas: vilken kanal som bär vilken bokstav, hur mycket ljusare än omgivningen en punkt måste vara för att räknas som en avläsning, och hur långt från en kärna en avläsning får ligga och ändå tillhöra kärnan. Detta är uppmätta egenskaper hos bildinsamlingen, inte personliga inställningar. Körningen rapporterar andelen biblioteksmatchningar, som visar om värdena är rätt.

records.key: How the tiles are put together and how the nuclei of each stitched well are segmented: the overlap the microscope left between neighbouring tiles, the overlap the segmentation windows share, and the model. Each read is attributed to the nucleus it falls on or just beside, so the model and the diameter here decide which objects can receive a barcode.
records.source: How the tiles are put together and how the nuclei of each stitched well are segmented: the overlap the microscope left between neighbouring tiles, the overlap the segmentation windows share, and the model. Each read is attributed to the nucleus it falls on or just beside, so the model and the diameter here decide which objects can receive a barcode.
records.translation: Hur bildrutorna sammanfogas och hur kärnorna i varje sammanfogad brunn segmenteras: mikroskopets överlappning mellan grannrutor, segmenteringsfönstrens överlappning och modellen. Varje avläsning tilldelas kärnan som den ligger på eller strax intill. Modellen och diametern här avgör därför vilka objekt som kan få en streckkod.

records.key: Where the tiles are read from and where the results are written: the sequencing folder searched, subfolders included, for tiles named by magnification, cycle, well, channels and site, the phenotype folder placed on top of it, the guide library the calls are matched against, and the folder that receives measurements.db and a report for each well. Set these first; every other OPS group assumes they are right.

records.key:
Report errors as GitHub issues
Reports go to the public spaCR repository on GitHub, with paths, names and credentials redacted. With issue reporting set to always, the default, a failed run files its report automatically, once per error, when GitHub is signed in below. With ask, a "File as issue" button appears under the console and the report is sent only when you press Send report in its preview. Change it under Help → Set spaCR up again….

records.key: A threshold correction factor: Otsu's level is multiplied by it before it is used. Above 1 is stricter, so objects shrink and faint ones drop out; below 1 takes in dimmer pixels; 1 is Otsu's own level. Otsu detect uses it, and so does the Live magnifier's Otsu mode wherever a region holds two clear populations.
records.source: A threshold correction factor: Otsu's level is multiplied by it before it is used. Above 1 is stricter, so objects shrink and faint ones drop out; below 1 takes in dimmer pixels; 1 is Otsu's own level. Otsu detect uses it, and so does the Live magnifier's Otsu mode wherever a region holds two clear populations.
records.translation: En korrigeringsfaktor för tröskeln: Otsus nivå multipliceras med faktorn före användning. Över 1 är striktare, så objekt krymper och svaga objekt försvinner. Under 1 inkluderar svagare pixlar. 1 är Otsus egen nivå. Både Otsu-detektering och Live-förstoringsglasets Otsu-läge använder faktorn när ett område innehåller två tydliga populationer.

records.key:
Adds spaCR's DEBUG messages to the log files in ~/.spacr/logs. It also lets cellpose report which model it loaded, and it records which buttons you pressed. That trail is what makes a bug report worth reading.

Starting spaCR and opening its screens took no longer with this on. This was measured on one workstation by opening every module, once with this on and once with it off. Home was ready in about 4 seconds after a cold start both ways. The slowest module opened in about 7 seconds both ways. Pipeline runs were not timed.

The Console still shows only the levels you switch on for it on the Logging tab. This switch does not trace every function call. That tracer is a separate tool for developers, and nothing here turns it on.
records.source:
Adds spaCR's DEBUG messages to the log files in ~/.spacr/logs. It also lets cellpose report which model it loaded, and it records which buttons you pressed. That trail is what makes a bug report worth reading.

Starting spaCR and opening its screens took no longer with this on. This was measured on one workstation by opening every module, once with this on and once with it off. Home was ready in about 4 seconds after a cold start both ways. The slowest module opened in about 7 seconds both ways. Pipeline runs were not timed.

The Console still shows only the levels you switch on for it on the Logging tab. This switch does not trace every function call. That tracer is a separate tool for developers, and nothing here turns it on.
records.translation:
Lägger till spaCR:s DEBUG-meddelanden i loggfilerna i ~/.spacr/logs. Det låter också cellpose rapportera vilken modell som lästes in och registrerar vilka knappar du tryckte på. Denna information gör en felrapport användbar.

Att starta spaCR och öppna dess skärmar tog inte längre tid med detta på. Mätningen gjordes på en arbetsstation genom att öppna varje modul med funktionen på respektive av. Home var redo efter cirka 4 sekunder från kallstart i båda fallen. Den långsammaste modulen öppnades efter cirka 7 sekunder i båda fallen. Tiden för analyskörningar mättes inte.

Konsolen visar fortfarande bara de nivåer du väljer för den på fliken Loggning. Denna omkopplare spårar inte varje funktionsanrop. Den spåraren är ett separat utvecklarverktyg och aktiveras inte här.

records.translation: Hur en punkt blir en bas: vilken kanal som bär vilken bokstav, hur mycket ljusare än omgivningen en punkt måste vara för att räknas som en avläsning, och hur långt från en kärna en avläsning får ligga och ändå tillhöra kärnan. records.key: How many brightness bands to cut the field into. 2 is Otsu's own split, one level between background and objects. Raise it where a field holds more than two populations — background, a dim halo and bright nuclei — and the cut moves off the one compromise level between all three onto the boundary you actually want, chosen below. Otsu detect only.
records.source: How many brightness bands to cut the field into. 2 is Otsu's own split, one level between background and objects. Raise it where a field holds more than two populations — background, a dim halo and bright nuclei — and the cut moves off the one compromise level between all three onto the boundary you actually want, chosen below. Otsu detect only.
records.translation: Antalet intensitetsklasser som bildfältet delas upp i. 2 är Otsus ursprungliga indelning, med ett tröskelvärde mellan bakgrund och objekt. Öka antalet när bildfältet innehåller fler än två populationer, till exempel bakgrund, en svag halo och ljusa kärnor. Då flyttas tröskeln från en gemensam kompromiss för alla tre till den gräns du vill använda och väljer nedan. Gäller endast Otsu-detektering.

records.key: How many pixels one press of Dilate or Shrink moves every object's boundary. The distance is the straight-line one, so 1 moves the edge onto its four neighbours and not its corners, and a Shrink undoes a Dilate of the same size on an object that had room to grow.
records.source: How many pixels one press of Dilate or Shrink moves every object's boundary. The distance is the straight-line one, so 1 moves the edge onto its four neighbours and not its corners, and a Shrink undoes a Dilate of the same size on an object that had room to grow.
records.translation: Hur många pixlar ett tryck på Utvidga eller Krymp flyttar varje objekts gräns. Avståndet mäts längs en rak linje, så 1 flyttar kanten till de fyra närmaste grannpixlarna men inte till hörnen. Krymp återställer en lika stor utvidgning av ett objekt som hade utrymme att växa.

records.key: How readily the Otsu mode accepts an object. Raise it to take in dimmer or less certain objects, lower it to keep only clear ones; 0 is the default cut. The models read their thresholds from the Object detection settings instead, so this is greyed out while another mode is chosen.
records.source: How readily the Otsu mode accepts an object. Raise it to take in dimmer or less certain objects, lower it to keep only clear ones; 0 is the default cut. The models read their thresholds from the Object detection settings instead, so this is greyed out while another mode is chosen.
records.translation: Hur lätt Otsu-läget accepterar ett objekt. Höj värdet för att ta med svagare eller mer osäkra objekt, och sänk det för att bara behålla tydliga objekt. 0 ger standardtröskeln. Modellerna hämtar i stället sina tröskelvärden från inställningarna för objektdetektering, så kontrollen är inaktiverad när ett annat läge är valt.

records.key: How the tiles are put together and how the nuclei of each stitched well are segmented: the overlap the microscope left between neighbouring tiles, the overlap the segmentation windows share, and the model. Each read is attributed to the nucleus it falls on or just beside, so the model and the diameter here decide which objects can receive a barcode.
records.source: How the tiles are put together and how the nuclei of each stitched well are segmented: the overlap the microscope left between neighbouring tiles, the overlap the segmentation windows share, and the model. records.translation: Hur bildrutorna sammanfogas och hur kärnorna i varje sammanfogad brunn segmenteras: mikroskopets överlappning mellan grannrutor, segmenteringsfönstrens överlappning och modellen. Varje avläsning tilldelas kärnan som den ligger på eller strax intill. Modellen och diametern här avgör därför vilka objekt som kan få en streckkod.

records.key: Show the picture as a negative and detect on that same negative: the field is normalized to 0..1 and each pixel becomes 1 minus itself, so its darkest pixel is its brightest. That is what lets Otsu and the Live magnifier, which look for bright objects, take DARK ones — a dark object on a pale brightfield reads the way a fluorescent one does, to the eye and to the detector alike. THE MASKS ARE MADE FROM THE INVERTED IMAGE while this is on, and a warning stays above the image saying so. The hover readout, the Filter category and the mask you save go on reading the image's real values, so nothing you measure changes. This is not 'Swap object and background' in Object operations, which flips a finished MASK and does nothing to the picture.

records.translation: Visa bilden som ett negativ och detektera i samma negativ. Bildfältet normaliseras till 0..1 och varje pixel ersätts med 1 minus sitt värde, så att den mörkaste pixeln blir den ljusaste. Därmed kan Otsu och det levande förstoringsglaset, som söker ljusa objekt, hitta MÖRKA objekt. Ett mörkt objekt i en ljus genomlysningsbild framträder då som ett fluorescerande objekt, både för ögat och för detektorn. MASKERNA SKAPAS FRÅN DEN INVERTERADE BILDEN när detta är på, och en varning ovanför bilden visar det. Avläsningen vid pekaren, kategorin Filter och masken som sparas fortsätter att använda bildens verkliga värden, så inget som mäts ändras. Detta är inte 'Swap object and background' under Objektoperationer, som inverterar en färdig MASK utan att ändra bilden.

records.key: Which model segments the region in the box. Otsu thresholds the region at Otsu's level and splits touching objects with a watershed; it needs nothing installed, follows the Min area box under Object operations and the threshold correction and the rest of the Otsu category, and runs whenever a model cannot be loaded. Adaptive threshold, LoG blobs, DoG blobs, Ridge filter, Hysteresis and U-Net are organelle detection's own methods, running through the same code as a mask run and reading the Detection methods category; the row's tooltip says what each suits. Cellpose uses the model, both thresholds, the diameter and the normalization set under Object detection, and is slow without a GPU. Cellpose 3 (cyto3, cyto2, cyto, nuclei), DINOCell and SAMCell are always listed and greyed until installed, and choosing one offers to install it into an environment of its own; Cellpose 3 reads both thresholds and the diameter set under Object detection, DINOCell reads the cell probability, and SAMCell uses its own thresholds.

Adaptive threshold, LoG blobs, DoG blobs, Ridge filter, Hysteresis and U-Net are organelle detection's own methods, running through the same code as a mask run and reading the Detection methods category; the row's tooltip says what each suits. Cellpose uses the model, both thresholds, the diameter and the normalization set under Object detection, and is slow without a GPU. records.translation: Vilken modell som segmenterar området i rutan. Otsu trösklar området med Otsus tröskelvärde och skiljer objekt som vidrör varandra med watershed.
